Class ScenarioDemographicSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioDemographicSectionBuilder
public class ScenarioDemographicSectionBuilder extends Object
Controller and UI builder for the Initial Population Identity Card and Demographic Density section.

Manages cellular demographic allocation: \[ P_i(t_0) = P_{\text{total}} \cdot \frac{\mathcal{W}(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{b}_i, K_0)}{\sum_{j} \mathcal{W}(\mathbf{x}_j, \mathbf{b}_j, K_0)} \] supporting procedural environmental suitability weighting, pre-calculated historical rasters (HYDE 3.4), and custom equirectangular PNG density imports.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
